table_title: List the 15 people who have held BOTH the office of US Vice President AND the office of US President during their careers per Wikipedia 'List of presidents of the United States' + 'List of vice presidents of the United States' masters. Universe predicate is the set intersection of {US Presidents roster as people} ∩ {US Vice Presidents roster as people}, intersected on person-identity via normalize_person_identity(). The intersection captures both direct-election VP-to-P transitions (Adams 1797 / Jefferson 1801 / Van Buren 1837 / Nixon 1969 / GHW Bush 1989 / Biden 2021) AND succession-of-predecessor transitions (Tyler 1841 / Fillmore 1850 / A. Johnson 1865 / Arthur 1881 / TR 1901 / Coolidge 1923 / Truman 1945 / L. Johnson 1963 / Ford 1974). For each dual-role person, give VP Number (sequential per Wikipedia VP list), VP Term Start Year (year inaugurated as VP), President Number (sequential per Wikipedia P list), and President Term Start Year (year inaugurated as P). Per cycle-1 audit edit #3: Ford's VP Number rendered with footnote marker in the source table (appointed under 25th Amendment after Agnew resignation 1973) is staged as plain numeric 40 (footnote-stripped). Per cycle-1 audit edit #4: scope is current as of 2026-05-21 source snapshot — current VP JD Vance and current President Donald Trump (47th) do NOT affect the intersection (Vance has not held P office; Trump 45/47 has not held VP office); the staged intersection extends only if a future VP later becomes President. Sort: VP Number ASC. Master-derived 15-row dump provided verbatim by cycle-1 pre-staging audit from both Wikipedia masters.
db_analog: WITH presidents AS (SELECT person_name, normalize_person_identity(person_name) AS normalized_person_id, president_number, term_start_year FROM us_presidents_master), vice_presidents AS (SELECT person_name, normalize_person_identity(person_name) AS normalized_person_id, vp_number, term_start_year FROM us_vice_presidents_master) SELECT v.person_name, v.vp_number, v.term_start_year AS vp_term_start_year, p.president_number, p.term_start_year AS president_term_start_year FROM vice_presidents v INNER JOIN presidents p ON v.normalized_person_id = p.normalized_person_id ORDER BY v.vp_number ASC
temporal_note: Two Wikipedia masters: 'List of presidents of the United States' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_presidents_of_the_United_States) + 'List of vice presidents of the United States' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_vice_presidents_of_the_United_States), accessed via cycle-1 pre-staging audit's master-derived 15-row dump on 2026-05-21. Universe is the closed canonical 15-entry set of people who have held BOTH offices. Per cycle-1 audit's required edits: (1) keep schema at 5 columns (no Succession Path 6th column — would introduce curator-classification surface not needed for clean set intersection); (2) Person names staged from VP list as displayed key, joined to president-list identity via normalize_person_identity() per cycle-2 PulitzerTonyPlays + automobiles precedent; (3) VP Number footnote markers stripped — Gerald Ford's VP Number rendered with footnote in the source table (because Ford was appointed VP under 25th Amendment after Agnew resignation 1973, NOT elected) is staged as plain numeric 40; (4) scope documented as current as of source snapshot 2026-05-21 — current VP JD Vance (50th VP under Trump 47 per live source — corrected from cycle-2 staging's '49th' per cycle-3 post-staging audit's HYGIENE fix) and current President Donald Trump (45th + 47th) do NOT affect the intersection because Vance has not held P office and Trump has not held VP office; the staged intersection extends only if a future VP later becomes President. Per-row cells: Person staged verbatim from Wikipedia VP master's name column with canonical forms ('John Adams' / 'Thomas Jefferson' / 'Martin Van Buren' / 'John Tyler' / 'Millard Fillmore' / 'Andrew Johnson' [NOT 'Lyndon B. Johnson' — disambiguation matters; 'Andrew Johnson' is 16th VP / 17th P succession-after-Lincoln-assassination], 'Chester A. Arthur' with middle initial + period, 'Theodore Roosevelt' [NOT 'Theodore Roosevelt Jr.' — that's TR's son who never held either office], 'Calvin Coolidge', 'Harry S. Truman' with 'S.' middle initial + period, 'Richard Nixon', 'Lyndon B. Johnson' with middle initial + period, 'Gerald Ford', 'George H. W. Bush' with both middle initials + periods + spaces, 'Joe Biden' [NOT 'Joseph R. Biden Jr.' — Wikipedia VP master uses short form]); VP Number sequential integer per Wikipedia VP list (1 / 2 / 8 / 10 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 25 / 29 / 34 / 36 / 37 / 40 / 43 / 47 — footnote-stripped per audit edit #3); VP Term Start Year integer year of VP inauguration per Wikipedia VP list (range 1789 to 2009); President Number sequential integer per Wikipedia P list (2 / 3 / 8 / 10 / 13 / 17 / 21 / 26 / 30 / 33 / 37 / 36 / 38 / 41 / 46); President Term Start Year integer year of P inauguration per Wikipedia P list (range 1797 to 2021). Notable calibration features: (a) **5 same-year VP-and-P start cases** = death-succession-in-same-year-as-VP-inauguration cases where the predecessor died in the same calendar year as the VP's inauguration: John Tyler (Harrison died April 1841, month after VP inauguration March 1841), Andrew Johnson (Lincoln assassinated April 1865, weeks after VP inauguration March 1865), Chester A. Arthur (Garfield assassinated September 1881 after July shooting, months after VP inauguration March 1881), Theodore Roosevelt (McKinley assassinated September 1901, months after VP inauguration March 1901), Harry S. Truman (FDR died April 1945, weeks after VP inauguration January 1945). Per cycle-2 post-staging audit's prose-precision clarification: these 5 are a strict subset of the 9 total succession-of-predecessor cases in the 15-row universe; other succession cases (Fillmore 1850 death-succession after Taylor died, years after his 1849 VP start; Coolidge 1923 death-succession after Harding died, years after his 1921 VP start; LBJ 1963 death-succession after JFK assassination, years after his 1961 VP start; Ford 1974 RESIGNATION-succession after Nixon resigned, year after his 1973 VP appointment) are valid succession cases but NOT same-calendar-year VP-and-P start; Ford specifically is the ONLY resignation-succession case in the universe (all other successions are death-succession). (b) **5 numerical inversions where President Number < VP Number** = succession-of-predecessor cases where the VP who succeeded a predecessor took a P-number numerically lower than their VP-number (because their P-succession came before their full P-elected-term filled the next P-slot): Truman 34VP/33P (FDR was 32P; Truman became 33P succeeding FDR), L. Johnson 37VP/36P (JFK was 35P; LBJ became 36P succeeding JFK), Ford 40VP/38P (Nixon was 37P; Ford became 38P succeeding Nixon resignation), GHW Bush 43VP/41P (Reagan was 40P; Bush became 41P via direct election following Reagan), Biden 47VP/46P (Trump was 45P; Biden became 46P via direct election; Trump is again 47P following Biden, but Trump is NOT in VP roster so this doesn't affect intersection). (c) **VP-end-to-P-start gap distribution** per cycle-2 post-staging audit's metric-precision clarification: using VP-tenure-end → P-tenure-start as the cleaner career-gap metric, Nixon has the LONGEST gap at 8 years (1961 VP end → 1969 P start); Biden's gap is 4 years (2017 VP end → 2021 P start) — second-longest. Most other VPs who became P had 0-year gaps (direct VP→P transition: Adams 1797→1797; Jefferson 1801→1801; Van Buren 1837→1837; GHW Bush 1989→1989) or succession-mid-tenure (the 5 same-year cases have 0-year VP-end→P-start gap since their VP tenure ended the moment they assumed P office). NOTE: this is distinct from VP-start-to-P-start (Biden = 12 years 2009→2021; Nixon = 16 years 1953→1969 longest by that alternative metric) — the two metrics give different longest-gap answers; the staged prose uses VP-end-to-P-start as the canonical career-gap metric per audit clarification. Set-operation framing: universe = US-Presidents-roster-as-people ∩ US-Vice-Presidents-roster-as-people; db_analog explicitly models the INNER JOIN on normalize_person_identity() (logically equivalent to INTERSECT on canonical-person-identity) with both source CTEs preserving role-specific attributes (P# + P-Year from presidents CTE; VP# + VP-Year from VPs CTE). The normalize_person_identity() intermediate accommodates potential name-form variants across the two masters (both masters use canonical short forms but defensive intermediate per cycle-2 PulitzerTonyPlays + automobiles precedent). temporal_sensitivity = low — universe grows ~1 every 20-30 years when a sitting VP later becomes President; Biden (2021) is most-recent dual-role person. Sort: VP Number ASC (source-natural chronological order by VP tenure per audit confirmation).
_extraction_notes: Set_operation instance — closed canonical 15-entry universe of people who have held BOTH US Vice President AND US President offices, constructed via set intersection of the two role-roster sets on person-identity. Single PK Person (15 closed values from Wikipedia VP master labels per cycle-1 audit edit #2). History/Politics existing subdomain (matches existing `twentieth_century_us_presidents_attributes` convention; NOT NEW — History family extends with 4th US-government instance joining twentieth-century-presidents + presidents-count-by-birth-state + scotus-appointments). people/politicians existing fine-class extension. Source plan: source_count=2 (Wikipedia 'List of presidents of the United States' + 'List of vice presidents of the United States' masters — both carry universe + value role for their respective role-set; intersection computed at integration time via normalize_person_identity() join). claim_type = source_defined per cycle-1 audit; both Wikipedia masters are authoritative role-rosters preserving source_defined cleanly. gt_construction = manual_wikipedia. All 4 edits applied at cycle-0 staging using audit's verbatim 15-row dump. 5-cell schema (Person PK + VP Number + VP Term Start Year + President Number + President Term Start Year) at 15 rows = 75 source-grounded cell values. Sort: VP Number ASC primary (source-natural chronological order by VP tenure per audit confirmation). Confidence gradient: very-LLM-knowable include John Adams (1st VP / 2nd P), Thomas Jefferson (2nd VP / 3rd P), Joe Biden (47th VP / 46th P), Lyndon B. Johnson (37th VP / 36th P succession after JFK assassination), Theodore Roosevelt (25th VP / 26th P succession after McKinley assassination); mid-difficulty include Truman 34VP/33P (FDR-succession + numerical inversion), Nixon 36VP/37P (only direct-election case with VP and P numbers close), Ford 40VP/38P (only person to become VP via 25th Amendment appointment AND P via predecessor-resignation; never elected to either office); harder calibration include 19th-century cases (Van Buren 8VP/8P / Tyler 10VP/10P same-number / Fillmore 12VP/13P / Andrew Johnson 16VP/17P / Chester A. Arthur 20VP/21P / Calvin Coolidge 29VP/30P), exact year-numerical-inversion patterns (5 cases: Truman/LBJ/Ford/GHW Bush/Biden where P# < VP#), 5 same-year VP-and-P start cases (Tyler 1841 / A. Johnson 1865 / Arthur 1881 / TR 1901 / Truman 1945 — death-succession-in-same-year-as-VP-inauguration cases per cycle-2 post-staging audit's prose-precision clarification; strict subset of the 9 total succession-of-predecessor cases in the universe; other succession cases including Fillmore/Coolidge/LBJ death-successions + Ford resignation-succession are valid succession but NOT same-calendar-year VP-and-P start). Set_operation category-fit: per the category contract, the row universe is constructed via set arithmetic on source-defined sets — US Presidents roster (closed canonical set per Wikipedia P-master) ∩ US Vice Presidents roster (closed canonical set per Wikipedia VP-master) = 15 dual-role people. db_analog explicitly models this INTERSECT operation via INNER JOIN on normalize_person_identity() (semantically equivalent to INTERSECT on canonical-person-identity). Mirror precedents: `plays_winning_both_pulitzer_drama_and_tony_best_play` (two-role intersection on entity-identity — just-completed instance with same set_operation INTERSECT shape), `physicists_who_were_nobel_laureates` (people in both physicist-set AND Nobel-laureate-set), `unesco_world_heritage_mixed_sites_attributes` (set INTERSECT of two designation-rosters), `aau_big_ten_intersection_universities` (set INTERSECT of two membership-rosters). Universe-stability features: (a) **Scope locked to source snapshot 2026-05-21** per cycle-1 audit edit #4 — current VP JD Vance (50th VP under Trump 47 per live source — corrected from cycle-2 staging's '49th' per cycle-3 post-staging audit's HYGIENE fix) and current President Donald Trump (45th + 47th) do NOT affect the intersection because Vance has not held P office and Trump has not held VP office; the staged intersection extends only if a future VP later becomes President; (b) **VP Number footnote-stripping** per cycle-1 audit edit #3 — Gerald Ford's VP Number rendered with footnote in the source table (Ford was appointed VP under 25th Amendment after Agnew resignation 1973, NOT elected) is staged as plain numeric 40; (c) **No Succession Path classification column** per cycle-1 audit edit #1 — would introduce curator-classification surface not needed for clean set intersection; calibration features for benchmark (direct-election vs succession-of-death vs succession-of-resignation) are inferable from year-cell patterns without requiring a separate column; (d) **Person names from VP list** per cycle-1 audit edit #2 — both Wikipedia masters use canonical short forms (John Adams / Joe Biden NOT longer corporate forms); defensive normalize_person_identity() at db_analog level.
